_about: Machine-readable map of every <gwi-chart> type, for the GWI design system (static charts in decks and reports). Keep in sync with the Chart types table in README.md. 'deckTemplate' is the matching template slide name in GWI-design-system-2026/Templates/Presentations/Presentation Template.html, or null when the deck has no slide for it yet. When deckTemplate is set, the deck slide wins. When it is null, redraw the chart statically from the rules in README.md ('The rules, built in') and the deck rules in the design system.

types.use: One hero number with supporting tiles
Several big numbers, each with a statement
types.static: Ovo numbers, small % beside each when unit is %. Two columns.

types.use: One tall bar stretching between big stats
types.static: Animated on the web. In a deck show the stats side by side, not looped.

types.use: Comparing values, one or several series
types.deckTemplate: Compare with bars / Compare one group with bars / Compare groups with bars

types.use: Parts of a total over time

types.deckTemplate: Show parts of a whole (stacked bar)

types.static: Same rules as the stacked bar template, turned to columns. Print values in the segments that fit.

types.deckTemplate: Show share with a half donut

types.static: Show every value on the ribbons (no hover in a static chart). Columns come from the flows.
Label every dot, names must not overlap. Group colours follow series order.

types.use: Comparing values per category on one line
types.static: Two or more series, a bar joins the dots. Print every value (hover is not available).

types.use: Change between two points in time
types.static: Smooth curves, one line per category. Highlight one line and grey the rest.

types.use: Inline insight: one share of a total
types.static: Card with a big number, rule, statement and a thin ring. Defaults pink.100 on neutral.40 in a neutral.30 card.

types.use: Inline insight: one share of a total as 10 by 10 dots
types.static: 100 dots, highlighted dots fill from the bottom right, right to left and upwards. Defaults lime.50 on neutral.40.

staticRules: Hover-only values on the web must be printed on the marks in a static chart.
Drop the buttons, 'View as table' and 'Download data'. Keep title, subtitle and key.
The source line, base and questions go in the slide or page footnote, as the Download image JPG does.
Colours, mark radius (6px), white gaps and the single % symbol follow the design system data viz rules.
